description: A wandering man who claims to be a former priest, Nicholas D. Wolfwood is a righteous man with a mission. Nearly at death's door when he first met Vash the Stampede, he would eventually share his life philosophy and serve as a friendly rival of sorts to the Typhoon's good-natured agenda. But he is not above bringing his massive weapon to fight injustice and evil—the pistols, machine gun, or rocket launcher hidden within it always have their uses. His beliefs about killing when necessary, however, soon bring him into conflict with the Humanoid Typhoon. Is Wolfwood hiding a secret?
summon: I'm a priest! A soldier of love, saving the lambs who have strayed!
fusion: And this is for you, this is for you, and this one is for me. I'm sorry, but is that good enough?
